restaurantName: Jin Ling Wang Jia Hun Tun (Jiqing Road)
address: 124 Jiqing Road, Qinhuai, Nanjing, China Mainland
bio: Back in 1983, the owner's father began selling wonton soup on a bamboo pole. Today, the same wonton soup attracts diners in droves and there's always a queue by the entrance to this place. The hand-wrapped wontons have thin skin and a generous juicy filling. Feel free to sprinkle with dried baby shrimps, pickled mustard stem and chilli oil. Scallion or bean paste flatbread makes a great companion to the dumplings. Open until 1pm; arrive early....
pageTitle: Jin Ling Wang Jia Hun Tun (Jiqing Road)
